subject.title: docs(release): add a release-train scope contract

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed mandatory train issue, six allowed change classes, and release-PR metadata as its permanent release-governance contract?
rationale: The patch can document the mechanism, but repository evidence cannot decide whether this exact governance taxonomy should constrain future release inclusion and automation.

options.title: Approve after shadow train
options.body: Exercise the contract on one complete advisory train, revise gaps found in practice, and approve the resulting docs and skill together.

options.title: Keep an advisory checklist
options.body: Retain goals, non-goals, captain, and exit criteria as optional guidance without making the six classes or metadata authoritative.

options.title: Keep the current SHA model
options.body: Decline the additional governance layer and continue using Code SHA, Release SHA, validation evidence, and explicit maintainer inclusion decisions.

recommendation.title: Approve after shadow train
recommendation.body: Exercise the contract on one complete advisory train, revise gaps found in practice, and approve the resulting docs and skill together.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged release-evidence work makes them the strongest available owner for evaluating the shadow evidence and gate semantics.
